fact_definitions.description: Romanian national medicinal-product CTR implementation applies. User-declared applicability fact; unknown when null.
Romanian medical-device clinical investigation rules apply. User-declared applicability fact; unknown when null.
Romanian patient-rights law applies to this research. User-declared applicability fact; unknown when null.
Romanian Law 190/2018 applies. User-declared applicability fact; unknown when null.
The author is subject to CMR professional rules. User-declared applicability fact; unknown when null.
Processing includes a Romanian national identification number. User-declared applicability fact; unknown when null.
The activity uses retrospective records only. User-declared applicability fact; unknown when null.
